test_module_protocol: test that Haiku Module instances satisfy the ModuleProtocol typing interface
test_supports_call: test that callable Haiku modules satisfy the SupportsCall typing protocol
test_no_subclassing: test that Haiku protocols cannot be directly subclassed without also inheriting Protocol
test_can_subclass_for_new_protocol: test that new protocols can be derived from Haiku protocols by also inheriting Protocol
run_typing_tests: run the absltest suite for haiku._src.typing to validate ModuleProtocol and SupportsCall behavior
